7.2.1 Classification
[SWS_BSW_00144] Error classification
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00385
⌈All errors, which may be detected and/or reported by a BSW Module, are classified
by the following types:
• development errors [SRS_BSW_00337]
• runtime errors [1, SRS_BSW_00452]
• production errors [1, SRS_BSW_00458]
• extended production errors [1, SRS_BSW_00466]
⌋
